title: Source storyboard (src/storyboard.json)
description: Engine-neutral description of a short film. Times are cues (see $defs/cue) that tools/resolve.mjs turns into seconds, writing web/film/storyboard.json for the engine. Positions are fractions (0..1) of the scene's box (a board panel, or the whole frame); sizes are px of a 1080-line frame at camera zoom 1. Keys starting with '$' or '_' are ignored (use them for comments).

vo.description: Optional voice-line list. Omit it to place every src/script.json line that has a src/words.json entry, in script order.

sfx.description: Synthesized sound events. resolve.mjs adds a whoosh for every camera move unless layout.whoosh is false.

camera.description: Explicit camera keys replace the automatic board path. Camera beats inside scenes are layered on top either way.

cues.description: Named cues, readable from custom shots with api.cue(name).

shots.description: Extra shot ids to load (web/film/shots/<id>.js). Shots used by custom elements and scenes are added automatically.

color.description: A palette key (ink, paper, board, accent, pencil, ...), a swatch name from config.palette.swatches, or any CSS colour.

cue.description: A time. 12.5 or "12.5" absolute seconds | "+0.8" relative to the previous cue in the same list (first entry: relative to the list's anchor, e.g. the scene start for beats) | "end" film end | "vo:<line>" line start | "vo:<line>.end" | "vo:<line>.w<i>" start of word i (0-based, mapped by index) | "vo:<line>.w<i>.end" | "beat:<n>" | "bar:<n>" (0-based, from src/beats.json or the synth bpm) | "scene:<id>" | "scene:<id>.end". Any non-relative cue may end in an offset: "vo:l2.w3+0.2", "end-1.5".

size.description: Output size in px, even integers: [1920,1080] 16:9, [1080,1920] 9:16, [1080,1080] 1:1. Wins over web/film/config.json.

seed.description: Base seed for boil, tilt and texture randomness.

type.description: stage: one full-frame scene at a time. board: a scrapbook grid of panels with a travelling camera.

grid.description: Board [columns, rows]; default fits the panel scenes.

panel.description: Board panel size in px (default about 92.7% x 92.6% of the frame).

gutter.description: Board gap between panels in px (default 35% and 40% of the panel).

caption.description: Board caption written in the top-left gutter (visible in the finale pull-back).

arrows.description: Board: ink arrows linking panels in viewing order, drawn during the finale.

doodles.description: Board: a ring stain and pencil sparkles in the gutters.

finale.description: Board: pull back to the whole board at the end. false disables it.

whoosh.description: Add a whoosh sfx to every camera move.

handheld.description: Hand-held camera drift amount; 0 = locked off.

music.description: The music bed. Needs asset or synth. The bed ducks under the voice with an envelope derived from each gap (gaps under 0.8 s stay ducked), rises after the last line and fades at the end.

asset.description: Path under web/, e.g. audio/music.mp3. A missing file is silence.

synth.description: A deterministic synthesized pad/pulse bed ($0 drafts). Beat k is at music.at + k*60/bpm.

progression.description: Scale degrees, 0-based, one per bar. Default [0,5,3,4].

offset.description: Seconds into the asset to start from.

end_at.description: Where the synth bed resolves (default: 0.15 s after the last line ends).

id.description: A src/script.json line id with a src/words.json entry.

at.description: Override the line start (default words.json t). Word cues move with it.

asset.description: Default: web/audio/vo_<id>.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a) if it exists, else no audio (captions only).

dur.description: Length for sustained sounds (rustle, scribble, whoosh, swish, ring, rumble).

pitch.description: Small integer variation for tap, tick, boing, boink.

scene.description: Frame this scene (its panel on a board).

focus.description: Point in the scene box (fractions) to centre on; default the centre.

x.description: World x in px when no scene is given.

z.description: Zoom; 1 = the box fills the frame.

zoomTo.description: Zoom about a fixed point (for pull-backs).

at.description: Required except on the first scene (default 0). "+s" is relative to the previous scene's start.

until.description: Default: the next non-overlay scene's start, or the film end. "+s" is relative to this scene's start.

overlay.description: Screen-space scene drawn above the camera (title cards, lower thirds); shown from at to until.

dim.description: Overlay: darken the picture behind it (0..1).

reads.description: What the viewer must understand here, in order; each read needs >= 1.2 s.

cell.description: Board [column, row]; default: scene order, row by row.

texture.description: Stage: paper grain on the background (default true).

custom.description: Escape hatch: a shot drawn over the scene's elements. A string is the canvas shot id; an object maps engine -> code reference.

params.description: Passed to the scene's custom shot as api.params.

element.description: One drawn thing. Common fields plus the fields of its kind. Canvas downgrades: equation renders as text, clip as its poster sprite.

id.description: Unique across the storyboard; also the element's boil seed.

pos.description: Centre, as fractions of the scene box (or group box). Default [0.5, 0.5].

boil.description: Stop-motion jitter amount (default 1; text and custom 0).

idle.description: Gentle de-synced idle motion (bob, sway, breathe).

cues.description: Named cues for a custom shot (api.cue(name)).

text.description: text / equation: the words (\n for line breaks; {n} is replaced by a count-up value).

style.description: title = ransom letters 110 px; heading = hand 80 px with underline; body = hand 48 px; label = print 32 px pencil; caption = print 40 px.

size.description: Font px at 1080p (minimum 28 for anything the viewer must read).

font.description: hand | print | ui | a CSS font stack.

w.description: text: wrap width px. sprite / clip / shape / group / custom: width px.

sub.description: text: a smaller, fainter second line (e.g. the technical name in brackets).

card.description: text: a torn paper card behind the text.

underline.description: text: ink underline after the write-on (colour name or true).

cps.description: text: write-on speed in characters per second (sets the default type-on length).

src.description: sprite: sticker name from web/img/manifest.json. clip: video path.

poster.description: clip: sticker shown on engines that cannot play clips.

shape.description: Paper cut-outs: rect ellipse circle triangle diamond star heart blob. Ink marks: arrow line ring check sparkle. tape: a strip of tape.

outline.description: paper shapes: ink outline on top.

from.description: arrow: start, fractions of the scene box.

to.description: arrow: end, fractions of the scene box.

points.description: line: points, fractions of the scene box.

rim.description: paper shapes: light torn rim (default true).

d.description: svg-path: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z).

bar_w.description: chart: bar width as a fraction of its slot.

children.description: group: children positioned in the group's box (w x h, default the scene box).

shot.description: custom: the shot id registered by web/film/shots/<id>.js.

params.description: custom: passed to the shot as api.params.

beat.description: A timed change to one element (or the camera). Beats run on stop-motion time (15 fps). An element whose first beat on a channel is an entrance (fade in, pop, slide in, type-on, draw-on, scale from 0) is hidden until that beat.

at.description: "+s" is relative to the previous beat in this scene (the first: the scene start).

target.description: Element id; required except for camera beats.

dur.description: Seconds. Defaults: fade 0.4, pop 0.3, slide 0.45, move 0.6, scale 0.35, draw-on 0.5, count-up 1.0, morph 0.5, camera 1.2, type-on = characters / cps.

until.description: Alternative to dur: end cue ("+s" relative to at).

from.description: fade/scale/count-up: start value. slide: [dx, dy] px offset to enter from (default [-240, 0]).

to.description: fade/scale/count-up: end value. slide: [dx, dy] px to exit to. move: [x, y] fractions of the box. morph: id of the element to become.

arc.description: move: hop height px (adds stretch in flight and a landing squash).

squash.description: move with arc: false turns the squash off.

focus.description: camera: point in the scene box to frame.
